title: Agent Result
description: Contract output written by a BYO agent to /app/agent_run/result.json. Only `status` is strictly required; every other field has a documented runner-side fallback. Unknown keys pass through (additionalProperties: true). Full contract: documentation/supplemental/BRING_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md.

status.description: Run terminal status. Agents write one of: 'completed' (finished cleanly), 'timeout' (SIGTERM/SIGKILL by harness wall-clock), 'error' (agent raised), 'unknown' (per-turn snapshot only; overwritten at final write). 'dry_run' is harness-only and never written by a BYO agent.

turns_taken.description: Number of completed assistant turns. Runner falls back to len(conversation.jsonl) when absent.

model.description: Effective model id. Runner falls back to task.model when absent.

final_message.description: Last assistant message text. Runner falls back to parser's last text buffer when absent.

exit_code.description: Subprocess exit code. Runner falls back to the observed subprocess exit code when absent.

error_traceback.description: Populated only when status='error'. Stack trace or short error message describing what went wrong (the runner also writes this for malformed result.json).

tool_call_count.description: Aggregate tool invocations. Runner derives by summing across conversation.jsonl rows when absent.

unique_tools.description: Distinct tool names invoked. Runner derives by union over conversation.jsonl rows when absent.

cost_usd.description: Total LLM cost for this run in USD. Agents that don't have a number MUST omit this key (not write 0). Runner-derived from token_totals × token_pricing.json when absent.

cost_source.description: Runner-only provenance. Agents MUST NOT write this. An agent-supplied cost_source without cost_usd is discarded (suppression-spoof guard). 'agent' = paired with the agent-reported cost_usd. 'derived' = computed by the runner from token_totals × token_pricing.json. 'derived_unpriced' = derive was attempted but the model has no row in token_pricing.json (cost_usd will be 0).

token_totals.description: Aggregate token counts. Open shape: parsers MUST forward cache sub-fields when the CLI reports them; extras pass through.

session_id.description: Cross-reference into CLI-side logs / provider dashboards.

stop_reason.description: Free-form CLI-native terminal reason (e.g. 'end_turn', 'refusal', 'max_tokens'). Refusals visible here for analysis; status still carries the harness-level rollup.

timing.description: Run timing. wall_ms set by the runner; api_ms and ttft_ms are CLI-specific (claude-code emits both).
